name: second-seat-payments
description: Second Seat: approval-gated PayPal payments. PayPal AI Hackathon 2026.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @second-seat/core && npm run build --workspace @second-seat/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @second-seat/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @second-seat/web && tsc --noEmit -p eval/tsconfig.json
scripts.eval: npm run build --workspace @second-seat/core && tsc -p eval/tsconfig.json && DRAFTER_MODE=stand-in node eval/dist/run-eval.js
scripts.eval:live: npm run build --workspace @second-seat/core && tsc -p eval/tsconfig.json && DRAFTER_MODE=live node eval/dist/run-eval.js
scripts.eval:recorded: npm run build --workspace @second-seat/core && tsc -p eval/tsconfig.json && DRAFTER_MODE=recorded node eval/dist/run-eval.js
